title: glad, unhappy, mad, and surprised faces by 9 months
summary: Most children show several facial expressions, glad, unhappy, mad, and surprised among them, by about 9 months, the milestone sheet says.
body: The four names are examples on the sheet line, introduced with 'like'. They are not offered as a closed set of human feelings. Showing more than one readable expression is the milestone. The publisher counts most children, 75 percent or more, and says the leaflet does not replace validated screening. This is the US wording.

sources.title: Milestones by 9 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Shows several facial expressions, like happy, sad, angry, and surprised'.
